_about: The phones Firebase Test Lab runs the device check on (DEVICE_LAB.md). Each wish names a 2022 phone by Test Lab model id or by a piece of its catalogue name; the first one the catalogue has is used, at the newest Android it offers. Ordered by priority: the free plan runs five physical devices a day, and `max` takes the first that many found. Spread across GPU makers on purpose: a driver bug (PowerVR under Opera) is what a frame-rate test alone never shows.
